headline: Europe's bio-based and advanced materials sector is policy-supported but commercially stretched: the large Nordic forest companies are restructuring around packaging while the EU builds demand-side support for bio-based content.
outlook_reason: EU policy (Bioeconomy Strategy, upcoming Biotech Act II, PPWR) and Horizon calls are favourable, but incumbents report weak, cost-inflated markets and bio-based content targets are not yet binding.

signals.title: Stora Enso Q3: forest demerger plan and packaging focus
signals.detail: Adjusted EBIT rose 28 % to EUR 161 million but missed forecasts. The board approved separating Swedish forest assets into a new listed company (Bergslagets Skogar), expected in H1 2027. Biomaterials profit rose on higher prices.

signals.title: UPM Q3: strong cash flow amid destocking and cost inflation
signals.detail: Comparable EBIT EUR 141 million vs 153 million a year earlier. Biofuels and energy carried results, which shows weak demand in the graphic and fibre businesses.

signals.title: Horizon Europe bridging and advanced-materials calls open
signals.detail: Calls on circular advanced materials (MAT-PROD-06) and on valorising project results opened in October 2026. Both suit university commercialisation.

signals.title: VTT/LUT F3 project: fully cellulose-based films and coatings
signals.detail: Reported oxygen barrier OTR below 1 cc/m2/day for films and below 0.2 for coatings, with grease barrier KIT 12. An industry partner says it can now commercialise them on paper and board. The date comes from the VTT announcement, which may differ slightly from the press date.

signals.title: Biotech Act II call for evidence closed
signals.detail: The Commission is preparing a second Biotech Act that includes lead markets for industrial biotech and bio-based materials. A proposal is pending.

signals.title: Cefic backs a single biomass-content target per product group
signals.detail: Cefic's June 2026 position counts both bio-based and bio-attributed inputs. This shows that definitions of bio-based content are still contested. The exact date is approximate.
